text:
Obstruction - Plastic jug - Lake Ontario - Oakville
Two orange foam cylinders with reflective tape marking the shipwreck "Bermingham Barge and Crane" replaced by a marker and a plastic jug at 43 26.015N 079 36.977W and 43 25.972N 079 36.985W. 
                                                    Cancels NW-C-3679-26
